verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring runs is a fair question for a browser-automation SDK and platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents a scheduler, cron, or recurring-trigger capability. Persisting user data between runs (stagehand-docs-7), caching (stagehand-docs-6) and deterministic replay (stagehand-docs-29) are adjacent features, not scheduling, so they earn no credit.
